weekly_theme.summary: 太陽剛進入射手座不久，生活重心可能悄悄轉往射手座相關的主題與氣氛。

aries.horoscope: 白羊座，您可能會發現，與他人建立聯繫會帶來豐厚的回報，特別是隨著一天時間的推移。分享您的活力，並在通常由您獨自處理的任務上進行合作。只要您保持樂觀積極的態度，一切應該都會順利進行。不要只是想著您的專案，請採取行動，推動專案向前發展。
aries.horoscope_en: Aries, you may find that connecting with others brings great rewards, particularly as the day progresses. Share your vibrant energy and collaborate on endeavors that you might typically handle solo. As long as you maintain a cheerful and positive outlook, everything should unfold effortlessly. Instead of merely thinking about your projects, take action and push them forward.

taurus.horoscope: 金牛座，今天最好早點把事情處理好，因為晚上可能會有一連串的活動。預期有些人會試圖用快速的談話和誘人的概念來影響您。在躍上新高峰之前，請確保您的基礎穩固。請控制好自己的情緒，以免將任何不滿發洩到周圍的人身上。專注於您的志向。
taurus.horoscope_en: Taurus, it's wise to get your matters in order early today, as the evening promises to bring a whirlwind of activity. Expect some to attempt to sway you with quick chatter and enticing concepts. Ensure your foundation is secure before you leap to new heights. Keep your emotions in check to avoid projecting any irritation onto those around you. Stay centered on your aspirations.

gemini.horoscope: 雙子座，好消息即將到來，特別是隨著一天過去。您會看到各種元素完美結合，營造出和諧的氛圍。您將能量向外引導的能力現在更加平衡，讓您能夠運用敏銳的機智、決心和智慧與他人互動。請記得掌握自己的步調，以舒適的速度處理任務，不必急於求成。
gemini.horoscope_en: Good news is on the horizon for you, Gemini, particularly as the day progresses. Expect to see various elements aligning seamlessly, creating a sense of harmony. Your ability to channel your energy outward is now more balanced, allowing you to engage with others using your sharp wit, determination, and intellect. Remember to pace yourself and tackle your tasks at a comfortable speed—there's no need to hurry.

cancer.horoscope: 巨蟹座，今天您可能會感覺到生活中的能量激增。可能有一些責任在呼喚著您。對於您無法履行的承諾，請謹慎行事。您的話語很有分量，因此重要的是，不要讓別人對您明知不會實現的結果抱有虛妄的希望。您對事情的發展有清楚的瞭解。無論情況如何，都要相信您的直覺。
cancer.horoscope_en: Today, Cancer, you might feel a surge of energy in your life. There could be responsibilities calling your name. Be cautious about making commitments you can't fulfill. Your words carry weight, and it's important not to give others false hope about outcomes you know won't materialize. You have a clear understanding of how things will unfold. Trust your instincts, no matter what the situation may be.

leo.horoscope: 獅子座，今天您可能會感覺到自己的攻擊性變強了。重要的是要意識到，這種強烈的情緒可能更多地源自您的反應，而非周圍的實際情況。您可能會與一個渴望和平的人發生衝突，而您卻傾向於捲入衝突。除非您努力改變觀點，否則這種矛盾可能會對您的心理健康造成負面影響。
leo.horoscope_en: Today, Leo, you may find yourself feeling a heightened sense of aggression. It's important to recognize that this intensity might stem more from your responses than from the actual circumstances around you. You could be clashing with someone who seeks peace, while you feel inclined to engage in conflict. This contradiction could take a toll on your mental well-being unless you make an effort to shift your perspective.

virgo.horoscope: 處女座，今天您可能會發現，當您抑制自己為所欲為的衝動時，您的情緒會出乎意料地發生變化。您可能會覺得自己被某樣東西的美所吸引，而不是執著於它。給予某人或某事自由可能是您最慷慨的舉動。透過保持開放的溝通，您會發現一切都完美契合。
virgo.horoscope_en: Today, Virgo, you might find your emotions shifting unexpectedly as you temper your urge to battle for what you want. Instead of clinging to something, you may feel drawn to appreciate its beauty. Granting freedom to someone or something can be the most generous gesture you make. By maintaining open communication, you'll discover that everything aligns perfectly.

libra.horoscope: 天秤座，隨著一天過去，您可以期待情況有所改善。一整天都專注於發揮您的務實與理性的一面，這樣您就能在晚上與朋友共度一段美好時光（如果可以的話）。今天，取得平衡對您來說至關重要，因此請留意維持平衡，避免生活中的任何方面失控。
libra.horoscope_en: As the day unfolds, Libra, expect improvements to come your way. Focus on harnessing your practical and logical side throughout the day, allowing you to enjoy some quality time with friends in the evening, if you can. Striking a balance will be crucial for you today, so be mindful to maintain equilibrium and prevent any aspect of your life from spiraling out of control.

scorpio.horoscope_en: You might find yourself feeling a bit frustrated in an area of your life, Scorpio, pushing you to take action. It's possible that your emotions are running high regarding a particular situation, and it would be wise to step back and assess the situation with a more rational perspective. You could be overlooking some clear truths simply because you're deeply immersed in your feelings.

sagittarius.horoscope: 射手座，您今天可能會感覺有點懶散，但隨著夜幕降臨，您會感到精力充沛。變革的風正朝著對您有利的方向吹，點燃您的激情！想像自己是一片乾旱的沙漠景觀，正等待那道火花點燃一場壯麗的盛宴。準備好像您本來就是的耀眼明星一樣，閃耀光芒，照亮周圍的世界。
sagittarius.horoscope_en: Today might feel a bit sluggish for you, Sagittarius, but expect a surge of energy as night falls. The winds of change are blowing in your favor, igniting your passions! Imagine yourself as a parched desert landscape, just waiting for that spark to ignite a stunning display. Get ready to dazzle and illuminate the world around you, just like the radiant star you truly are.

capricorn.horoscope: 在一天剛開始時就處理好您的任務，這樣就能在晚上放鬆身心，無憂無慮。讓自己頭腦清醒，以便稍後能有效地與他人分享關鍵見解。擁抱獨特的觀點；記得走自己的路，而不是迎合他人的期望。
capricorn.horoscope_en: Tackle your tasks early in the day to enjoy a relaxed evening without worries. Clear your mind to effectively share key insights with others later on. Embrace a unique perspective; remember to follow your own path rather than conforming to others' expectations.

aquarius.horoscope: 水瓶座，今晚您可能會感受到一股意想不到的能量爆發，讓您擺脫平時悠閒的態度。雖然您通常喜歡輕鬆自在，但有些事情可能會激勵您振作起來並採取行動。與他人互動將激發您的動力，推動您朝著目標前進。當您獲得渴望的認可時，您的投入與奉獻精神將大放異彩。
aquarius.horoscope_en: Tonight, Aquarius, you might experience an unexpected surge of energy that shakes off your typical laid-back demeanor. While you often prefer to take it easy, something may inspire you to rise and take action. Engaging with others will ignite your motivation and drive you to pursue your goals. When you receive the recognition you crave, your commitment and dedication will shine brightly.

pisces.horoscope: 雙魚座，您今天可能會遇到一些情緒波動，特別是隨著一天過去。採取更理性的心態，而不是被情緒所左右，可能會有幫助。您可能會經歷劇烈的情緒波動，從一個極端擺盪到另一個極端。您此刻真正需要的，特別是今晚，是一種平衡感。專注於解決任何未竟之事，有助於恢復您的平衡。
pisces.horoscope_en: Pisces, you might encounter some emotional turbulence today, particularly as the day progresses. It could be beneficial to adopt a more rational mindset rather than getting swept away by your feelings. You may experience intense mood fluctuations, swinging from one extreme to another. What you truly need at this moment—especially this evening—is a sense of balance. Focus on resolving any unfinished business to help restore your equilibrium.
